practiceReport.beatComment: The wideout had one of his more productive games of the season before being injured, as he caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown. practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (81%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Rankins sustained an apparent ankle injury during the second quarter of Thursday's contest, and he was able to walk gingerly to the sideline under his own power. In his absence, rookie second-rounder Kayden McDonald figures to see an increase in snaps on the defensive line.

practiceReport.name: Keylan Rutledge
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (98% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (82%)
Beat/podium consensus: on track to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: The Texans announced Rutledge's injury in the waning moments of the contest, but he had been in the medical tent well before that time. Febechi Nwaiwu took over at left guard following Rutledge's departure. With Houston not set to play again until Sunday, Nov. 29, against Baltimore, Rutledge will look to recover from the stinger in time to suit up.

practiceReport.name: Trent Brown
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (12th NFL season, 91% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Brown left Thursday's contest after suffering a back injury, but he was able to check back in with the Texans' field goal team in the second quarter. With that said, veteran Braden Smith was still working as Houston's right tackle when the first half of Thursday's game ended.

practiceReport.name: Jake Hummel
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: The linebacker suffered the injury in Week 1, returned for Week 10 and then carried a questionable tag into this contest, but he appears ready to play through the injury for the second consecutive game. Hummel logged two tackles (one solo) across 21 special-teams snaps against the Browns last week.

practiceReport.name: Jaylin Smith
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: The cornerback was activated from injured reserve earlier in the day Thursday and will be making his first appearance since Week 4. Smith played just seven defensive snaps across the first four games of the season.
